description: This file contains command implementations for managing task flows, including listing, showing details, and canceling flows, with functions for formatting and summarizing flow data.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum number of characters, adding an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: safeFlowDisplayText
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates flow display text, returning 'n/a' if input is empty.

methods.name: shortToken
methods.description: Returns a truncated version of a token string, defaulting to ID_PAD length.

methods.name: formatFlowStatusCell
methods.description: Formats flow status with color themes based on status.

methods.name: formatFlowRows
methods.description: Generates formatted table rows for a list of flows.

methods.name: formatFlowListSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string of flow statuses.

methods.name: summarizeWait
methods.description: Summarizes the waitJson property of a flow.

methods.name: summarizeFlowState
methods.description: Provides a summary of the flow's current state.

methods.name: flowsListCommand
methods.description: Lists all flows, optionally filtered by status, with JSON or formatted output.

methods.name: flowsShowCommand
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific flow, including linked tasks.

methods.name: flowsCancelCommand
methods.description: Cancels a flow identified by a lookup token.
